verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities. Brand Templates can be made accessible to teams for on-brand design (canva-docs-15), and brand kits and templates can be accessed and managed (canva-docs-20), which partly covers sharing styles and templates across a team. Nothing describes publishing reusable components into a shared library that links into other files, or propagating updates when the source changes. Missing for 10: a shared component library linked across files and projects, a controlled update or versioning flow when the source changes, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
